nodes.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive architecture and setup guide for the Waggle Marketplace package, covering the unified package catalog (skills, plugins, MCP servers from 40+ sources), multi-layered security gate design (Gen Trust Hub, Cisco Skill Scanner, MCP Guardian, custom heuristics, content hashing), sync engine, CLI reference, and Waggle Server API integration patterns.
nodes.languageNotes: 31-section document covering the full marketplace architecture including SQLite schema, multi-layer security pipeline, package types (skills/plugins/MCP servers), capability packs, and CI/CD integration guidance.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @waggle/marketplace v0.1.0, defining the unified package catalog and installer for skills, plugins, and MCP servers with better-sqlite3 as the sole runtime dependency and a CLI binary entry point (waggle-market).

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the marketplace package targeting ES2022 with strict mode, ESNext modules, bundler module resolution, and declaration map generation.
